taskstaffAuthorityFor: delivery shortfalls, gaps, and work acceptance
nonAuthoritativeFor: unilateral code merge or release authority

missions.name: Governed request-to-accepted-PR delivery
missions.objective: Assemble the correct agent and human reviewer team for a scoped engineering request, preserve implementation and test evidence, and deliver a reviewed and accepted pull request.
missions.why: Fast agent execution is only valuable when scope, corrections, security review, tests, authority, rollback posture, and acceptance remain visible and controlled.

roles.title: Request owner
roles.responsibility: Define the desired outcome, constraints, acceptance criteria, and business priority.

roles.title: Planner or scout agent
roles.responsibility: Inspect the repository and evidence, identify dependencies and uncertainty, and prepare a reviewable implementation plan.

roles.title: Implementer agent
roles.responsibility: Produce bounded code changes and attach provenance, test, and limitation evidence without self-approving the result.

roles.title: Independent code reviewer
roles.responsibility: Review correctness, maintainability, tests, regressions, and requested-change closure independently from implementation.

roles.title: Release authority
roles.responsibility: Approve merge or deployment only after required evidence, reviewer separation, and rollback readiness are complete.

controls.title: Agent implementation and human acceptance separation
controls.description: Prevent the same agent execution result from serving as implementation, verification, review, release, and business acceptance evidence.

controls.title: Evidence-gated release
controls.description: Require scoped diff, tests, review closure, security checks where applicable, deployment plan, and rollback evidence before release approval.

controls.title: Engineering claim integrity
controls.description: Require high-risk claims about production, security, customers, compliance, cost, and external systems to cite evidence or remain explicitly unverified.

expectedShortfalls: The requested skill, reviewer, environment access, or test infrastructure may be unavailable.
An agent may produce a change without sufficient repository context or acceptance criteria.
Release evidence or rollback proof may be incomplete.
resultingGaps: A pull request may be delayed, returned, or released with unresolved risk.
Reviewers may spend excessive time reconstructing scope and evidence.
The organization may overstate autonomous-delivery capability.
prohibitedAutomation: No agent may unilaterally merge, deploy, approve security risk, waive tests, or accept the business outcome.
No agent-generated summary may replace source diff, test, review, or runtime evidence.

marketingProof.proofStatement: Demonstrate that TaskStaff can govern a mixed human-and-agent engineering team from scoped request through reviewed and accepted pull request.
proofGates: Run only against a test repository until scopes and credentials are approved.
A human must approve consequential repository and release actions.
Outcome claims require comparable baseline and pilot work classes.
prohibitedClaims: Do not claim autonomous software delivery, zero review, or production deployment without verified evidence.
Do not claim faster delivery or fewer defects without outcome-verified measurements.

implementation.nextAction: Validate the manifest and run a synthetic request-to-PR mission with planner, implementer, reviewer, release authority, evidence gates, and acceptance.
